reception: The reception centers on the false sharing detectors that followed. SHERIFF, PREDATOR, and Cheetah position their designs against its instrumentation-based approach, ScaAnalyzer differentiates its scalability analysis from it, and the DARWIN framework adopted its ideas for detecting false sharing in OpenMP applications. A second strand cites the paper as evidence — that false sharing degrades performance on multicore machines, or that dynamic binary instrumentation can expose it — while the remaining citations are passing mentions in work on contention, scheduling, and performance analysis. The engaged readership is small and concentrated among builders of sharing detectors, for whom the tool is the design each successor explains itself against.
